mergedParams.userDescription: Clean text lines rising from the bottom, stacking perfectly. typo kinetics for titles/captions/other text..

output.title: Clean Rising Text Lines - Typographic Animation

prompts.prompt: Create a typographic kinetic preset where text lines rise from the bottom like movie credits, but with modern stacking animation. Each line should emerge with a subtle elastic bounce, rising smoothly from below the viewport (translateY: 100vh) and settling into its final position with a gentle overshoot. As new lines appear, previous lines should compress slightly (scale down to 0.95) and fade back (opacity to 0.7) creating a depth hierarchy. The most recent line stays at full opacity and scale. Think of it like building a tower of text where each new block compresses the foundation slightly. Use staggered timing where each line begins its animation 0.3 seconds after the previous one starts, creating a cascading effect. The rise animation should use a custom spring easing for that organic, professional motion feel.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container with 'flex flex-col justify-end items-center h-full relative overflow-hidden' for bottom-anchored stacking. Each text line uses a TextAtom wrapped in BaseLayout with 'w-full text-center py-2'. Effects: Generic keyframe effects array with translateY (100vh to 0), opacity (0 to 1), and scale (0.95 to 1 to 0.95 for compression). Use spring easing for translateY, ease-out for opacity. Timing: Each line has relative timing starting at index * 0.3 seconds, duration 1.2s for rise animation. Previous lines get a secondary effect at the same trigger time to compress/fade. Performance: Add 'will-change-transform' to animated elements, use transform3d for GPU acceleration.

prompts.prompt: Design a minimalist typokinetic preset inspired by Apple Keynote presentations where text lines materialize from transparency and slide up subtly. Each line should fade in while simultaneously moving up just 20-30 pixels, creating an elegant reveal. The key here is restraint - no bounces, no overshoots, just smooth, confident motion. Lines should stack with generous spacing (think luxury brand typography) and maintain perfect alignment. Use a very slow ease-in-out curve (duration: 1.5s) to give weight and importance to each text element. Previous lines should remain fully visible but shift up smoothly to make room, like a well-choreographed elevator system. This creates a reading flow that guides the eye naturally upward.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'flex flex-col-reverse justify-start items-center min-h-screen px-8 py-16' for elegant spacing. TextAtom components wrapped in BaseLayout with 'mb-8 w-full max-w-4xl'. Effects: Subtle translateY (-30px to 0) combined with opacity (0 to 1) using ease-in-out. Existing lines get translateY animation (-spacing amount) when new lines appear. Timing: 1.5s duration per line with 0.5s overlap between consecutive lines. Use fitDurationTo: 'children' to adapt to content. Style: Large typography with 'text-5xl font-light tracking-wide' for that premium feel.

prompts.prompt: Build a dynamic news ticker-style typokinetic preset where text lines shoot up from the bottom with high energy, then stack tightly like breaking news alerts. Each line should blast in with acceleration (ease-in), hit a slight shake effect on arrival (like impact vibration), then settle. The shake should be a rapid 3-frame oscillation in translateX (±5px). Stack lines close together with minimal spacing to create urgency. Add a subtle red glow pulse to newly arrived text that fades after 0.5s. Think CNN breaking news energy - fast, attention-grabbing, slightly aggressive. Previous lines should instantly jump up (no animation) to make room, maintaining the rapid-fire feeling.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'flex flex-col justify-end items-stretch h-full bg-black' for news ticker aesthetic. TextAtom in BaseLayout with 'px-4 py-1 border-l-4 border-red-500'. Effects: Primary - translateY (100% to 0) with ease-in (0.3s), followed by shake effect using multiple translateX keyframes (0, 5px, -5px, 0) over 0.1s. Add glow effect with textShadow animation ('0 0 20px rgba(255,0,0,0.8)' to transparent). Timing: Rapid 0.3s entry, 0.15s between lines. Performance: Use transform-origin: bottom for better stacking physics.

prompts.prompt: Craft a poetic typokinetic preset where text lines float up like smoke or bubbles, with organic, meandering motion. Each line should rise with a gentle wave pattern (combining translateY with subtle translateX sine wave oscillation). The motion should feel weightless and dreamlike, with lines becoming increasingly transparent as they stack higher (creating a fog effect at the top). New lines emerge fully opaque and bright, older lines fade to 30% opacity. Add a very subtle blur increase (0 to 2px) for distant lines. The overall effect should feel like thoughts rising from the subconscious, ephemeral and flowing.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'relative h-full overflow-hidden' container. Inner BaseLayout with 'absolute inset-0 flex flex-col justify-end items-center'. Effects: Combine translateY animation with translateX using Math.sin for wave motion (amplitude: 30px). Opacity decreases based on stack position (1 - (index * 0.15)). Blur filter increases with position. Use custom wave calculation in presetExecution. Timing: Slow 3s rise per line with 0.8s overlap. Easing: linear for translateY to maintain floating feeling. Style: 'text-3xl font-serif italic opacity-90' for poetic aesthetic.

prompts.prompt: Develop a retro arcade-style typokinetic preset where text lines slam up from the bottom with 8-bit game physics. Each line should appear instantly at the bottom (no fade), then slide up in discrete, stepped movements (like pixel-perfect animation). Create a stepped easing by using multiple keyframes at specific percentages (0%, 25%, 50%, 75%, 100%) with instant transitions between them. Add a digital glitch effect on arrival - brief RGB channel separation using CSS filters. Lines stack with pixel-perfect spacing (multiples of 8px). Include optional scanline overlay effect using repeating linear gradient. Think classic arcade game UI - sharp, digital, nostalgic.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'relative bg-black h-full font-mono' for retro terminal look. TextAtom with 'text-green-400 uppercase tracking-wider'. Effects: Stepped translateY using multiple keyframes without transitions between them. RGB split using filter with multiple drop-shadow values offset by color channels. Add chromatic aberration: 'drop-shadow(-2px 0 red) drop-shadow(2px 0 cyan)'. Timing: 0.5s per line with instant steps at 25% intervals. Use linearstep custom easing. Style: 'text-2xl' with 'image-rendering: pixelated' for authentic pixel look.

prompts.prompt: Create an elegant editorial typokinetic preset inspired by high-end magazine layouts where text lines rise and stack with sophisticated timing. Each line should rise with a two-stage animation: first a quick rise (60% of distance in 0.3s), then a slow, graceful deceleration into position (remaining 40% in 0.7s). This creates a 'catching breath' effect. Lines should stack with variable spacing based on content hierarchy (titles get more space). Add a subtle tracking (letter-spacing) animation that tightens as the text settles. Previous lines should gracefully dim (not fade) by reducing brightness to 0.8. The overall feel should be refined, editorial, and purposeful.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'flex flex-col justify-end items-center max-w-6xl mx-auto px-12'. Variable spacing using conditional classes based on text type. Effects: Two-stage translateY animation using cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) for first stage, ease-out for second. Letter-spacing from 0.1em to 0 during settle. Brightness filter for dimming (100% to 80%). Timing: Total 1s per line, split into 0.3s rise + 0.7s settle. Add 0.4s delay between lines for readability. Style: Mix 'text-6xl font-bold' for titles with 'text-2xl font-light' for body text.

prompts.prompt: Build a glitchy cyberpunk typokinetic preset where text lines emerge from digital corruption at the bottom and reassemble while rising. Each line should start as scrambled characters (using random letter substitution), then unscramble during the rise animation, revealing the actual text. Add datamosh-style artifacts - occasional horizontal displacement glitches and color channel shifts. Lines stack with irregular spacing (randomly vary between 4-12px) to feel broken/hacked. Include neon glow that pulses with different colors (cyan, magenta, yellow) for each line. The rise should stutter occasionally, pausing briefly at random points like buffering data.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'relative bg-gray-900 h-full overflow-hidden'. TextAtom wrapped with scramble effect logic in presetExecution. Effects: Custom text scrambling using character replacement in a helper function. TranslateY with random pause points using multiple keyframe stops. Color/textShadow animation cycling through neon colors. Add random translateX glitches (±10-20px) at specific keyframes. Timing: Variable 0.8-1.2s per line (randomized), with random 50ms pauses. Use internal effect preset for glitch artifacts. Style: 'font-mono text-cyan-400' with dynamic glow 'text-shadow: 0 0 10px currentColor'.

prompts.prompt: Design a fluid typography preset inspired by water dynamics where text lines rise like air bubbles through liquid, accelerating as they ascend. Each line should start slowly at the bottom, gradually speed up (inverse ease-out), and gently bob when reaching their position (subtle oscillation using translateY sine wave for 2-3 cycles). Lines should have a refractive quality - slight scale distortion (scaleX varies between 0.98-1.02) and blur that clears as they settle. Previous lines should ripple slightly when new lines pass through them, like water displacement. Add a subtle blue-tinted color shift that fades as text rises, simulating depth in water.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'relative h-full bg-gradient-to-b from-blue-50 to-blue-100'. TextAtom in BaseLayout with 'relative z-index based on stack order'. Effects: TranslateY with custom acceleration curve using cubic-bezier(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0.5). Oscillation effect post-arrival using Math.sin with decreasing amplitude. ScaleX fluctuation (0.98 to 1.02) with random phase offset. Blur filter (2px to 0) during rise. Color animation from 'text-blue-900' to 'text-gray-800'. Ripple effect on existing lines using small translateY displacement when new lines pass. Timing: 2s rise time with acceleration, 1s oscillation period with damping. Performance: Use will-change: transform, filter for smooth animation.

prompts.prompt: Create a musical/rhythmic typokinetic preset where text lines rise in sync with an implied beat pattern, like visual sheet music. Each line should pulse up from the bottom in a rhythmic bounce - quick rise (0.2s), brief hold at peak (0.1s), gentle settle (0.3s). Stack lines with musical spacing - wider gaps every 4 lines (like measures in music). Add a subtle scale pulse on arrival (1.0 to 1.1 to 1.0) synced with the bounce timing. Include optional integration with audio analysis - if audio data is available, sync the rise timing to detected beats. Lines should have a subtle rotation oscillation (-1deg to 1deg) to feel alive and dynamic, like they're dancing into position.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'flex flex-col justify-end items-center gap-2' with conditional 'gap-8' every 4th line. TextAtom with dynamic timing based on audio beats if available. Effects: Multi-stage translateY for bounce motion (100% to -10% to 0) with different easings per stage. Scale pulse (1.0 to 1.1 to 1.0) timed with settle. Rotation oscillation using transform: rotate with sine wave calculation. Optional: Use waveform effects if audio analysis available - tie rise timing to beat detection via fetcher API. Timing: Total 0.6s per bounce cycle, stagger by 0.4s or sync to audio beats. Style: 'text-4xl font-bold' with 'transform-origin: bottom center' for proper bounce physics.

prompts.prompt: Develop a cinematic title sequence typokinetic preset where text lines emerge from darkness with dramatic Hollywood-style motion. Each line should start completely black (brightness: 0) and far below, then rise while gradually illuminating like stage lights turning on. Use a exponential brightness curve (0 to 100% with ease-in-out-expo). Lines should have massive initial scale (3x) that reduces to 1x during rise, creating a zoom-in effect. Add letterboxing bars (black bars top/bottom) that expand to reveal each line. Stack with generous cinematic spacing. Include a subtle film grain texture overlay and optional lens flare effect on the newest line. The motion should feel epic and weighty, like opening credits of a blockbuster film.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'relative bg-black h-full flex flex-col justify-center items-center' with letterbox overlays using absolute positioned divs. TextAtom with 'text-white mix-blend-screen'. Effects: Combined translateY (200% to 0), scale (3 to 1), and brightness filter (0 to 100%) all with ease-in-out-expo (2.5s duration). Letterbox animation using scaleY on overlay divs. Film grain using CSS noise filter or SVG turbulence. Lens flare using radial-gradient pseudo-element that tracks with text. Timing: Slow 2.5s per line with 1s overlap for dramatic build. Style: 'text-7xl font-black tracking-widest uppercase' for that blockbuster impact. Add 'text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(255,255,255,0.5)' for glow.
